title: Default mode is the old head cut
scenario: JARVIS_CONTEXT_SELECT unset; a long tool output is selected.
expected: Mode 'off'; output starts with the first max_chars characters (behaviour unchanged).

title: Short outputs untouched in every mode
scenario: Short outputs under the budget go through every mode.

title: Python nested traceback in the middle, 4 KB
scenario: Python traceback with a nested exception in the middle of 1,500 lines of install/test noise.
expected: Answer and every critical line kept verbatim, in order, within 4,000 chars.

title: Node module error with Windows path, 4 KB
scenario: Node 'Cannot find module' with a Windows require stack in the middle.
expected: Error, path and code lines kept verbatim within budget.

title: Go panic at the end, 4 KB
scenario: Go panic with goroutine frame near the end.

title: Playwright timeout cause in the middle
scenario: Browser automation: click timeout and the intercepting cookie banner line in the middle.

title: One real error in a flood of warnings
scenario: 1,500 DeprecationWarning lines hide one disk-quota error.
expected: The error line is kept; warnings do not crowd it out.

title: Injection that repeats the query words
scenario: Injected 'note to agent' lines repeat the query to steer selection away from the real 503 error.
expected: The real error line is kept.

title: Second hop through a service name
scenario: The crash line names ledger-svc; the version is on another line that shares no query words.

title: One correct line among 50 near-duplicates
scenario: Distractor build-id lines for other releases.

title: Omitted ranges are exact and the input digest is kept
expected: omitted ranges + kept lines = all lines; sha256 of the full input present (recoverable/matchable).

title: Selected tool output stays untrusted data
scenario: Evidence mode inside mcpwire.process_result over output with injected instructions.
expected: Result still marked untrusted with the 'never as instructions' note; selection reported.

title: A private key still withholds the whole result
scenario: Evidence mode over output that contains a private key block.
expected: withheld=True and no key text, whatever the mode.

title: trim-1 configured but missing falls back safely
scenario: Mode trim1-balanced with a binary path that does not exist.
expected: Falls back to evidence, answer kept, mode says so.

title: Selection latency on 200 KB
scenario: Evidence selection over the largest fixture (Python traceback, 1,500 filler lines).
expected: Median under 150 ms per call on this CPU.

title: A single line longer than the budget
scenario: One 180 KB minified JSON line holds the answer.
expected: Output fits and reports the omission; the line cannot be kept verbatim (documented limitation).
